chapter: Return to New York, addiction, health and the NBC job
title: Dating the Santa Barbara and Rex Stewart jobs
summary: Willard pins the 1960 Santa Barbara job and the 1961 Rex Stewart gig.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: You were talking about the gig with Rex Stewart and another one with Jimmy Rawles, and we didn't really talk about what year those were. Can we nail it down to time?
Well, I returned here in Los Angeles on Pearl Harbor Day. It was December the 7th. And --
Of '60. And I worked a job over at the California Club for a short space of time.
Yeah. Santa Barbara. That was Christmas of '60. For a saxophone player, and I never got paid for it.
I can't remember his name. I hounded him. I went over to his house. I threatened to break up all the

furniture in his house. He says, 'This isn't my house. This is my sister's house,' and he disappeared. I don't know where he went to. Anyway, that was Christmas week, and then New Years, of '60. '61, I don't recall too much of a bang. I guess I was out of it most of the time. Outside of a gig here and a gig there. One nighters, you know.
